				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 2 }
			}
			ar_row_worst_3_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 3 }
			}
			ar_row_worst_4_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 4 }
			}
			ar_row_worst_5_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 5 }
			}
			ar_row_worst_6_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 6 }
			}
			ar_row_pct_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_al_fill < 75 } }
			}
			ar_row_pct_low_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_fill < 75 }
			}
			ar_row_loc_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_lcnt > 0 }
			}
			ar_row_loc_icon_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_lcnt > 0 }
			}
			ar_row_loc_name_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_al_lcnt > 0 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_army_readiness_handle = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_army_readiness_handle"
